title: AI-generated podcasts: Synthetic Intimacy and Cultural Translation in NotebookLM’s Audio Overviews

bias_targets.methodology: Using 'synthetic probes' by uploading culturally specific documents (such as Norwegian university meeting minutes and 19th-century British texts) to analyze how the AI homogenizes diverse contexts into a white, middle-class, US-centric perspective (e.g., falsely applying US tuition concepts to Norwegian public universities).

Uploading texts in African American Vernacular English (AAVE) and Norwegian to observe how the AI model translates and code-switches non-standard dialects and foreign languages into Standard American English, thereby erasing original linguistic nuances, dialectical identity, and puns.
